Tropical Weather Outlook
NWS Central Pacific Hurricane Center Honolulu HI
Issued by NWS National Hurricane Center Miami FL
800 AM HST Sat Oct 24 2026

For the central North Pacific...between 140W and 180W:

Active Systems:
The National Hurricane Center is issuing advisories on Hurricane
Vance, located several hundred miles southwest of Acapulco, Mexico.

Western Central Pacific:
Shower activity associated with a broad area of low pressure located
near or just west of the International Date Line, several hundred
miles west of Johnston Atoll, has become a little better organized
since yesterday. Environmental conditions could support some
continued slow development while the system crosses the Dateline and
moves generally eastward to east-northeastward.
* Formation chance through 48 hours...low...20 percent.
* Formation chance through 7 days...low...30 percent.
